name: germany_poland_1939
description: Germany (A) invades Poland (B), September 1939, at state granularity. Real states, adjacency, terrain and rivers from the 1.19.5 map; the force counts, hubs, objectives and time limit are assumptions of ours.
assumptions: Sides: Germany's own states plus the former Czechoslovak states (69-74, 9) are side A; every Polish state is side B. Lithuanian, Latvian, Soviet and Romanian states are left out, so the Soviet invasion and every flank beyond Poland are not modelled.

Forces are about 40 percent of the historical order of battle (a sim of about 55 against 40 divisions is too slow to benchmark): 22 German divisions (18 infantry, 4 armour) against 20 Polish infantry. The templates are the sim's inf_9 and armor_6; Poland's thinner equipment is not modelled.
Hubs: Brandenburg for Germany; Warsaw and Lwow for Poland.
Objectives and limit: take Poznan, Lodz, Krakow and Warsaw within 30 days. The historical campaign took Warsaw in 27 days; the objective set and the limit are ours.
Rivers come from map/rivers.bmp by a threshold heuristic of ours (realmap.py), not a game rule.
One simulator province per state, 12 hour steps.
